correctness.rationale: The graph is identified by an exact cubic ring edge equality; 24 vertices, 60 distinct edges, each degree five, 32 triangles. Two distinct integer recurrences exhaust all 16,777,216 labelled subsets (each once) and agree for every cardinality; all sector maxima and counts and all rational affine lower-envelope transitions are replayed. Proof gives the exact recurrences, normalization H=J(60-2B)-hM, field boundaries and integer multiplicities. This is a fully exhausted finite case, not a sampled approximation.

value.rationale: A complete field-dependent zero-temperature magnetization and coexistence-entropy profile for the canonical 24-spin chiral Archimedean network directly used in frustrated Ising finite-cluster approximations answers a specific physically motivated question. The otherwise unknown low-field 201-fold coexistence and full constrained maximum-cut profile sharpen a prior heat-capacity comparison; a graph-independent methodology or known high-field independent-set f-vector does not yield these numbers. No broader infinite-family theorem is claimed.
